summary.text: Sarah Lightner is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 45 who has held a seat in the Michigan House since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Lightner's career experience includes co-operating a crop farm and working as a paralegal.
She has been affiliated with the Jackson County Farm Bureau, the Springport FFA Alumni and Boosters, and the National Association of Counties.
Lightner's tenure in the Michigan House began in 2019, and she has represented District 45 since January 1, 2023.
She served on the House Appropriations Committee from 2019 through 2024, including as minority vice chair in 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026; in the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Judiciary Committee and also sits on the Agriculture, Insurance and Financial Services committees.
